name: Everything Will Be Alright needs the Auchindoun chain that makes Greatfather Aldrimus visible (#8183)
contract: Greatfather Aldrimus (19698) starts and ends quest 10164 and carries Ancestor Invisibility (32648, invisibility type 4).
spell_area grants Commune With The Ancestors (32649, invisibility detection type 4) in area 3688 only once Vision of the Dead
(10252) or Material Components (10045) is rewarded, so a character without either can never see the ender.
Expected: a level 68 Human with no Auchindoun quest cannot take 10164; after Vision of the Dead is rewarded he can.
